original_proposal.title: Multiple faint replacements may continue after successful replacement-path escape
original_proposal.claim_context: WP41 says declining the next creature and receiving a positive escape return ends the battle. It does not name that the already-running replacement scan continues through later fainted player seats. WP42 already correctly says positive decisions are not a universal immediate-return lock; that text must be preserved.

premise.entry: Ordinary internal wild 2v1; one player owner; no partner, debug, special battle type or plugin. At initial setup there were at least three able player members, so 2v1 is supported and retained.
premise.state: At EOR replacement entry, seats0 and2 have formally fainted; one non-egg able reserve P remains and the wild foe remains alive; decision0 and canRun true. First seat retains raw speed100, fastest opposing raw speed50. No form/status/item/ability callbacks alter these values or decisions.
premise.interaction: At seat0 choose not to use the next creature. Its duringBattle escape reaches speed comparison and succeeds deterministically. At the subsequent seat2 prompt choose Yes and select P; callbacks and presentation return normally.
premise.hazard_variant: P has HP1, is grounded, has no effective boots/Magic Guard/healing/exit interference; own side has one Spikes layer and no position-heal effect. Damage is at least1 and P has no other able reserve.

ordinary_controls.input: Only one fainted player seat needs replacement; no prior switch in the pass; successful escape.
ordinary_controls.expected: No later fainted-player prompt exists; empty switched set ends replacement loop and decision remains3.

ordinary_controls.input: Same multi-faint state, but first prompt chooses Yes and a legal reserve.
ordinary_controls.expected: Ordinary replacement occurs without first setting escape decision3.

ordinary_controls.input: Positive result already present before ordinary replacement entry.
ordinary_controls.expected: Entry result guard returns immediately; this does not refute a result written inside the running scan.

minimal_counterexample.steps: First prompt declines; calculation writes escape3 and returns1. The current seat does not replace, but the scan advances to seat2, asks again, accepts P and binds/sends P at seat2. The pass then runs entry-position and hazard processing.
minimal_counterexample.expected_observation: Second prompt and the later replacement happen after the escape success feedback; no immediate return occurs at that first success. With nonlethal/no hazards and no other result producer, the enclosing EOR later returns with decision3.
minimal_counterexample.minimum_impact: Extra input, member binding/display order and entry-effect submissions after successful escape feedback.

stronger_counterexample.steps: Keep the same legal post-faint state and interaction, but use the HP1/Spikes variant. The later entry applies hazard damage, formally faints P, then calls the ordinary judge.
stronger_counterexample.expected_observation: All player participants now unable while foe alive; ordinary judge overwrites3 with2. EOR sees2 only after replacement returns. HP0 and formal faint prefix are already committed.
stronger_counterexample.qualification: This stronger vector is independently derived by proposer from fully read source; M01 challenge independently supports the nonlethal continuation, not the final lethal extension. No game/model/host execution.

lifecycle_trace.behavior: Per-seat decline calls the replacement escape path; positive return makes only that seat skip replacement.
Speed advantage writes3 after success feedback; duringBattle keeps the attempt count unchanged.
The running scan lacks a result guard before later seats or before pass entry notification.
Later legal replacement binds persistent member identity and changes temporary display order before entry callbacks.
Position heal and hazards still run; hazard fainting can invoke ordinary judging.
Ordinary judge has no positive-result exemption and can overwrite3.
Outer EOR checks result only after replacement call returns.

original_proposal.failure_cancellation_partial_commit: Cancelling the earlier decline is not a rollback operation: No initiates escape. A later required reserve chooser has its own cancellation permission. The escape feedback/result, later replacement and entry effects commit at their individual points; an exception later in display, selection or entry is governed by existing diagnostics and gives no transaction rollback guarantee. Do not claim final3 for every variant.

negative_evidence.scope: Entire ordinary Battle and Battler subtrees read; ordinary replacement loop and immediate callers/consumers inspected continuously. Only BattleArena overrides replacement in the locator search, and it is excluded.
negative_evidence.counterevidence_preserved: WP42 L51/L135 already provides the correct generic non-immediate-exit rule; this finding is only the concrete WP41 replacement-path contract.

original_proposal.impact: An independent implementation that short-circuits all replacement work at first escape success would suppress later prompts and entry submissions and cannot reproduce the bounded reference outcome. This is a specification fidelity issue, not an instruction to repair reference code or permanently preserve its anomaly.
original_proposal.minimal_correction: Qualify WP41 L123: positive replacement escape sets a result, but the current multi-seat replacement scan can continue before the caller checks it. Give the two-seat continuation vector and state that later entry/judge effects may change the result. Preserve all normal escape probability and guard rules.

recommended_write_set.scope: Only §5.1 success wording and necessary nearby invariant cross-reference.
Add one bounded multi-faint escape continuation vector plus independent nonlethal/lethal/control variants; update the SW count/list only if a new ID is added.

acceptance: No wording implies an immediate inner-loop exit at first successful replacement escape.
Single-faint and entry-positive-result controls retain their current outcomes.
Multiple-faint vector observes second prompt/binding after success; lethal variant distinguishes the later ordinary-judge overwrite from the first result assignment.
Existing WP42 generic mutable-result and checkpoint contracts remain intact; tests remain explicitly NOT_EXECUTED.

history_and_sync.relationship: No historical verdict adopted. Related existing WP42 non-immediate result rule is preserved. Root owns historical deduplication.
dependent_specs: WP42 §3.2 and phases21–22 as retained context
shared combat test catalog SW vectors
history_and_sync.future_compatibility: User decision; proposal documents observed static reference control flow without prescribing implementation.

independent_challenge.limitation: Does not independently certify the HP1 lethal extension; root final disposition still required.

independent_adjudication.scope: Primary correction WP41:123 and neighboring replacement vector; preserve WP42 generic delayed-decision-consumption contract. Independent core is continued nonlethal replacement/state commit after decision3; proposer lethal-result extension is not promoted to independent proof.

original_proposal.title: Direct-opponent helper cannot guarantee a living result from its preference flag
original_proposal.claim_context: The helper inventory parenthetic says a non-fainted opponent can be required. Actual behavior is a preference input whose first-existing-fainted branch terminates the preferred scan and then returns the same first existing member through fallback. The surrounding inventory does not state that exception.
original_proposal.premise: Valid1v3 seats0/1/3/5; queried user0, order3/5/1; seat3 exists but has fainted; seats5 and1 alive. No mutation during lookup. Direct query only; no runtime/menu observation.

minimal_counterexample.input: Direct-opponent query for user0 with prefer-unfainted true.
minimal_counterexample.expected_static_result: Seat3; a filtered living-order interpretation would produce seat5.
minimal_counterexample.partial_commit: Read-only raw query; no HP/party/choice persistence write is caused by the query itself.

ordinary_controls.input: Seat3 absent rather than present and fainted.
Explicit opposing-seat5 input to throw-ball resolution.
ordinary_controls.expected: Uses seat5 directly; does not call the own-side direct-opponent helper.

bounded_consumer_vector.input: Q1 state, legal direct throw-ball call using own seat0; legal ball/content and callbacks.
bounded_consumer_vector.expected: Raw helper gives3, then capture fallback chooses the first living same-side ally of3 in global seat order, seat1; capture calculation receives1, not ordered successor5.
bounded_consumer_vector.observation_boundary: Before the capture calculation/randomness. No guaranteed capture success or failure.
bounded_consumer_vector.normal_menu_limit: The fully read ordinary ball menu supplies an explicit living opposing target or a Foe selection. No normal-menu reachability of the own-side three-foe input is asserted.

lifecycle_trace.behavior: Creates the supported-layout direct-opposition preference ordering.
First existing fainted member stops preferred traversal; fallback returns first existing member.
For own-side input, first-living-ally fallback can recover from a fainted raw result.
Filters living same-side members and preserves global slot traversal order.
Ordinary menu supplies explicit opposing target; does not prove the direct auxiliary-call path.

original_proposal.failure_cancellation_partial_commit: Raw lookup is read-only. Any later capture attempt has its own writes, cancellation and failure contract; no new claim of inevitable no-target failure is made. A no-living-ally direct throw may have an existing nil failure already documented by WP38; do not reopen it under this finding.

negative_evidence.scope: All primary Battle/Battler code and full ordinary command scene read. Explicit true call locator finds only capture; M02 independently checked default callers and confirms their flag is false/default.
counterclaims_rejected: Normal target menu must choose the wrong foe
Every move-targeting family uses this helper
A living-filter guarantee holds whenever any foe lives

original_proposal.impact: An implementer treating this parenthetic as a strong query postcondition may return a different seat on a legal bounded auxiliary request. Gameplay impact through the ordinary menu remains unproven; this is a P3 contract precision proposal.
original_proposal.minimal_correction: Replace require-unfainted with a preference description and name the first-existing-fainted fallback exception. Preserve ordered opposition table, absent-seat skip, capture living-ally fallback and existing no-live-target boundary.

recommended_read_set.qualification: Read by independent challenger M02; proposer has not semantically read this formal interval.

recommended_write_set.scope: Only helper parenthetic or linked bounded query rule.
Raw query counterexample, living/absent controls, and direct capture recovered-target boundary; update BC count if new IDs added.

acceptance: Preference flag is no longer a universal living-result guarantee.
Q1 returns3, Q2 returns3, Q3 returns5 in the static contract.
Direct consumer vector expects recovered target1 rather than generic capture failure.
Normal explicit-target menu, WP38 fallback and all other move target construction rules preserved.

history_and_sync.relationship: Independent challenger identified that WP38 already documents fallback/no-live behavior. This proposal only corrects WP39 helper precision. Root owns historical deduplication.
dependent_specs: shared combat test catalog BC vectors
history_and_sync.future_compatibility: No requirement to permanently retain an anomalous helper implementation; user compatibility decision remains separate.

independent_challenge.proposer_response: Accepted narrowing; ordinary-menu reachability and inevitable capture failure removed. Root final disposition pending.

independent_adjudication.scope: Narrow WP39 helper contract and raw-query vector only. Preserve WP38 living-ally fallback and ordinary menu explicit-target route; no claim of inevitable capture failure or permanent source-defect compatibility.

original_proposal.title: 内核紧急保存合同应区分真实备份效果与无旧档成功时仍显示的备份提示
original_proposal.severity_reason: 只影响无旧档紧急保存成功后的消息验收与跨合同理解；不主张新增保存损坏、也不主张规范明确禁止该提示。

specifications.clause: §5.2成功提示及‘仅在存在旧档时成立’

premises: 固定参考、无覆写，超时已到紧急保存入口。
有玩家，其他必需状态与持久登记值合法，保存前主档不存在。
正常保存返回真，两个消息入口均正常返回；不执行真实文件或宿主。
original_proposal.normal_control: 同样有玩家但已有旧档，复制正常且保存成功：先复制备份，随后依次出现已保存及旧档已备份两提示。
original_proposal.minimal_counterexample: 仅把正常对照的‘已有旧档’改为‘没有旧档’，仍令保存成功：复制分支未到，但两个成功消息仍依次调用。MG07没有区分不真实的提示与实际文件效果，§5.2也未清楚登记此无旧档提示。

outcomes.normal: 无旧档成功时新建保存尝试完成，并依次提示已保存、旧档已备份；没有本次旧文件复制。
outcomes.cancel: 该入口没有交互确认/取消门，不把关闭提示当作保存取消。
outcomes.failure: 返回假时只有保存失败消息；复制异常可使保存尚未到达；无玩家提示后返回。
outcomes.partial_commit: 场景先置空；正常保存前缀及可能文件写入已发生。后续消息失败时不保证恢复旧场景，也不回滚保存；仅正常到底才恢复。

necessary_consumers.disposition: 已正确记录成功依次两个提示；须保留并作为最强反证。
T15已有旧档正常对照正确；无旧档成功对照可补或交叉引用。
只有超时到达该分支；两模式紧急保存前诊断差异保留。

negative_evidence.patterns: previous save file has been backed up|旧档已备份|紧急保存|emergency
negative_evidence.result: 仅一个源消息发出点，未见无旧档条件包围该成功消息；明确发现WP65正确双消息合同，因此不是全正式集完全遗漏。
negative_evidence.qualification: 全范围关键词结果是定位/负证据而非全仓语义阅读；相关命中随后连续读取。

original_proposal.strongest_refutation: ‘成立’可以仅说明实际备份陈述真假；WP65 §4.2已准确说明两个成功消息。因此当前合同可合并正确解释。本条只提出LOW级内核表述/验收补明，不声称现有文字无歧义地规定隐藏消息。

independent_refutation.outcome: 独立阅读同一源/规范三位置，确认源两提示无旧档门；提出‘成立’可能只描述真实性的反证，仍支持作清晰化建议。主会话仍需裁定。

original_proposal.title: Accepted mapping data needs a callable precondition before generic handler triggering
original_proposal.impact: A reader can treat accepted mapping data as a successfully triggerable callback and derive a return value where the fixed source instead raises before any handler effect. This is a narrow compatibility/failure-boundary omission, not a default gameplay failure.
original_proposal.severity_reason: Only direct use of a generic trigger with validly registered noncallable mapping data is affected. Default menu consumers intentionally extract and invoke a named function from mapping data; their normal behavior is correct.

specifications.clause: Accepted handler shapes followed by trigger return contract
Menu mapping data and named subfunction consumer; preserve correct behavior
EP04 validates registration ordering but does not cover accepted noncallable triggering

premises: Fixed reference snapshot, no extensions giving ordinary mapping data callable behavior.
Fresh generic identity-handler table; supported nonempty text identity X.
Register an ordinary empty mapping as X, with no extra block or concurrent mutation; registration returns normally.
Direct generic trigger of X with no args; separate menu function consumer is not used.
original_proposal.normal_control: Register a normal callable for X whose result is 7, then generic trigger normally returns 7 without prepending X. Trigger an unregistered identity normally returns no value.
original_proposal.minimal_counterexample: The ordinary mapping is accepted and retained at X, but direct trigger tries to invoke it as a callback. Because an ordinary mapping has no callable operation, a missing-call error propagates; no normal result is produced. The stored mapping remains registered.

outcomes.normal: Callable handler returns its result; absent handler returns no value.
outcomes.cancel: There is no confirmation or cancellation interaction at these primitive entries.
outcomes.failure: Accepted noncallable mapping fails at invocation, not registration; no local catch converts it to empty/false.
outcomes.partial_commit: Registration has already stored X. Failed triggering does not remove it or roll back earlier external state; no mapping effect was invoked.

necessary_consumers: MenuHandlers.add accepts option mappings through the same identity-handler registry.
MenuHandlers.call retrieves a mapping and invokes its selected named function, so a mapping with effect callback remains a valid menu option.
Content-key variants use the same accepted-shape check and invoke resolved values as callbacks, so the same callable scope should be made explicit if their trigger contract is expanded.

negative_evidence.scope: All Markdown under deliverables/final-specification-set searched; WP05 full1–147 and kernel catalog full1–288 continuously read. Global search is locator evidence, not global read credit.
negative_evidence.expression: Mapping/handler/trigger, HandlerHash, callable and Chinese callable/valid/invalid-handler terms.
negative_evidence.conclusion: No generic callable-precondition caveat in the owned full contract/catalog; line57 describes the distinct correct menu consumer. A final bounded whole-formal-set search produced only WP05 row30 and WP21 line26; WP21 lines20–37 were then continuously read and describe a distinct timing-to-handler mapping consumer rather than generic triggering of mapping data.
negative_evidence.limitations: Earlier broad relevant-hit search output was truncated in tool display, with full raw stdout archived. Final bounded search output was fully read. Global nonowned hits are not counted as full-file reads or blanket absence proof.

not_executed: No behavioral model, real plugin, game host, UI, map/demo event or file mutation was executed.
original_proposal.smallest_correction: At WP05 row30 qualify normal generic triggering with a callable-handler premise. Explain that registration also accepts mapping data for consumers such as menus, but direct generic triggering of an ordinary noncallable mapping raises at invocation. Preserve missing-handler empty result and all registration validation/order semantics.
preserve_scope: Do not reject mapping data at registration.
Do not change menu option data storage or selected-function dispatch.
Do not add failure isolation, rollback or future framework architecture.
Do not generalize to every domain-specific mapping consumer.
original_proposal.synchronization: Add narrow catalog callable/noncallable/missing/menu controls. Source traceability and feature-matrix audit synchronization should be decided by root without changing reference.
acceptance: Text distinguishes accepted data shape from callable trigger precondition.
Callable result and unregistered result stay correct.
Ordinary mapping registration succeeds, direct trigger failure is acknowledged, mapping remains stored.
Valid menu mapping effect function still invokes and returns normally.
All new vectors remain static NOT_EXECUTED.

formal_locations.clause: §6.1; source-level F8 trigger is recorded without file workflow

premises: Default input update reaches its F8 pressed-edge check and no plugin replaces the helper.
Host supplies the given wall-clock value, working directory and data directory; primary/fallback write outcomes are explicitly supplied inputs.
Only directory/file request identity, sequencing and source exception handling are inferred; no screenshot pixels, real filesystem or host exception type was executed.
original_proposal.ordinary_control: With no F8 edge the helper is not requested. With F8, a usable Screenshots directory and normally returning screenshot host, the request targets that relative directory and no fallback path is requested.

minimal_counterexample.given: F8 edge, working directory A, host data directory B distinct from A, primary Screenshots directory writable, screenshot request normally returns.
minimal_counterexample.source_result: The request targets A/Screenshots with a wall-clock date/time-to-millisecond PNG basename, rather than B. After a primary directory/write failure, the same basename is requested beneath B instead.
minimal_counterexample.contract_gap: WP17 only states that F8 triggers a screenshot. The accurate WP65 help label says same folder as save but is explicitly content, and cannot determine this actual two-stage path workflow.

normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.normal: Name a .png from the current wall-clock fields, ensure the relative Screenshots directory and request the primary capture.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.cancel: There is no interactive confirmation/cancel operation in this helper; absence of the F8 edge does not request it.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.primary_failure: Directory setup or primary capture failure enters the fallback and requests the same basename via the host data-directory filename resolver.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.fallback_failure: A fallback failure escapes this helper; later completion sound request is not reached.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.partial_commit: Any already-created directory or successfully requested screenshot has no source rollback; a later completion-sound failure does not imply file rollback. Millisecond filename granularity does not prove uniqueness.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.sound: Only after normally returning capture does the helper conditionally request the named completion sound when its resource check succeeds; actual audio is unknown.

original_proposal.severity_reason: 普通默认 Repel 等步进效果可在零位移撞墙完成时推进；独立实现若把步数严格绑定成功位移，会改变道具时长与周期效果。不是纯排版问题，也不据此声称宿主事故或默认毒伤。

spec.clause: §4.1 普通移动/碰撞入口及开始-完成说明
§8 碰撞仅音效/计数/标记摘要

original_proposal.premise: Use vector BP01 in full, including initial facing direction and absent encounter/automatic/forced/interpreter gates; keep start and completion observations separate. The normal case uses default field-poison-off configuration and does not need poison or custom code.
original_proposal.source_fact: A failed cardinal player attempt without successful touch creates a timed collision motion at unchanged logical coordinates. Character update later clears that motion, sends a general step notification and marks this update as moved. Player post-update sees that flag, passes its no-current-motion/automatic-movement gate and calls player step handling without requiring coordinate change. Normal player handling increments the global counter and publishes player notifications; the non-ice Repel consumer decrements.
original_proposal.ordinary_control: An unobstructed cardinal step also increments after completion but has an earlier logical displacement/distance increment. A failed diagonal or successful touch has no new collision motion and cannot be substituted.

minimal_counterexample.input: 20x20 valid map; player (5,5) facing right, ordinary walk, current ordinary ground, (6,5) all-direction blocked, no events/through/debug/encounter/ice/waterfall/forced route/interpreter/menu/plugin/unrelated writes; one healthy non-egg creature; global count 0, friendship counter 0, repel 2, distance D, bump count B. One right attempt, then release directions and allow uninterrupted valid updates, each delta <=0.25, until the collision motion completes.

original_proposal.title: WP34 §9.10 的“两个槽位个体不被写入”漏掉亲本动态形态读取的持久提交
original_proposal.severity_reason: 在明确合法作者数据变体中会改变仍寄存的亲本形态，并可写图鉴；只允许缓存填充会使后续独立实现或测试漏掉持久副作用。该反例不是随附默认DEERLING已带继承标志的断言。
original_proposal.author: R7-M07
original_proposal.premise: 合法作者数据变体：只给默认DEERLING基础记录附加InheritFormFromMother字符串标志，其它记录/引用/三个季节形态有效，假定已有效装载；未改参考、未运行编译。两亲本合法普通非蛋非Shadow、母为DEERLING雌/父为适配雄，均无强制形态；母存储形态0、未先动态读取；月份2，非战斗/非储存模式，依赖正常，无插件。直接生成或正常寄养生成均无额外亲本只读屏障。
original_proposal.ordinary_control: 默认未加该标志的DEERLING不会经母系形态分支读取母方form；默认SHELLOS有母系标志但没有动态getForm处理器，仍按BR27–31对子代同值提交，不能概括为所有默认繁殖都改亲本。
original_proposal.minimal_counterexample: 上述作者变体在母系继承取值时先读取母方动态形态。二月得到1，与母方存储0不同，因而母方先提交1，完成清特性缓存、重算及条件图鉴登记，再把返回1提交给子代。父母仍是原引用；母方持久形态已经改变，不仅是派生缓存填充。

original_proposal.severity_rationale: Seen/form/accessibility can change on a normal own-side sendout. The owned-but-unseen state is constructible by a documented public acquisition variant; restricting registration to opponents loses observable records. No need to run a special or malformed battle.
premise: Ordinary internal battle; player object and its battle player are the same; no plugins/extra callbacks or independent form submission.

Previously constructed valid non-egg healthy ordinary male nonshiny BULBASAUR form0; owned already true, seen/forms/last absent. This is produced by party-only silent admission with see_form=false, not by ordinary silent gift admission.
Valid current map/region0 content and refresh dependencies; no Illusion, Transform, forced/dynamic form, capture or fainting before observation; sendout presentation returns normally.
Read immediately after actual own-side sendout registration, before unrelated later events.

minimal_counterexample.setup: Admit that existing BULBASAUR by party-only silent entry with see_form=false; seen remainsfalse and ownedtrue as existing PD24 correctly states. Use it as the sole healthy active player member in a normal internal battle against a different already-seen species.
minimal_counterexample.action: Complete the normal player initial sendout.
minimal_counterexample.actual_static_result: Initial sendout constructs both sides, then sends side0 through the common sending-out consumer. That consumer registers every supplied battler; the wrapper only checks existence/internalBattle, not allegiance. BULBASAUR becomes seen, its ordinary male form0 becomes seen, initial last tuple becomes[0,0,false], and accessibility refresh can add region0. Owned remains true; no catch/defeat count is added by this registration.
minimal_counterexample.ordinary_control: An already-seen own member performs an idempotent re-registration; an opponent sendout still follows the existing documented path. A reserve not actually sent is not registered by this common sendout call. Noninternal wrapper invocation skips these record writes (independent form commits remain their separate contract).
minimal_counterexample.additional_consumer: Normal player replacement and partner sendout also pass through the same common consumer; no implementation hierarchy need be specified.

normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.normal: Record write occurs after the sendout presentation call returns; player/partner/opponent are not separate registration gates.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.cancel: If a replacement selection is canceled before replacement/sendout, this sendout registration is not reached. Opening/canceling a menu alone is not evidence of a write.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.failure: A presentation/peer callback failure before common registration can stop before the writes. Record refresh failure, if introduced, may leave earlier seen/form/last writes; no transaction implied.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.partial_commit: The acquired owned-only state is legitimate before sendout; battle registration fills seen/forms/first-last without re-owning, counting a capture, or undoing admission.

outcomes.normal: 记录MIDI用途和随附音色库身份；文件存在时的游戏层交付继续沿既有合同，不断言加载成功。
outcomes.cancel: 静态配置无用户取消动作；播放包装nil/空名提前返回沿原合同，不推音色库加载、释放或取消。
outcomes.failure: 缺/坏SF2、guard值、字段缺省/无效值、原生解析或宿主错误结果UNKNOWN，保留L09；BGM参数错误的有限重试不概括SF2错误。
outcomes.partial_submission: 配置为静态声明，无本任务写入事务。音频逻辑登记可能先于宿主交付，后续失败不承诺统一回滚；不制造原子资源加载合同。

original_proposal.reviewer: R7-C07 /root/m02_creature_state; independent of M04 diagnostics_localization author

source_to_consumer.fact: 三字体声明y偏置均8，字号分别27/21/27。
选择字体时同时将对应偏置写到绘制目标。

original_proposal.title: 名人堂登记的BGM请求早于记录写入，正文“先于演出”未分层

location.target: L141“记录写入（先于演出）”；L143将BGM列作演出首项。L22未写BGM先后，不判它错误。

seven_groups.1_identity_and_scope: 固定B/R及三树；只比较当前登记入口内的逻辑BGM请求/记录写入，不认证声音、像素、地图事件可达或落盘。
seven_groups.2_precise_claim_and_fact: 源Hall L67–74：完成基础显示构造后，在非空音乐配置下先请求音乐，再登记克隆记录。正文L141的无条件“先于演出”若包括其L143首项BGM，会给反向次序。逐成员视觉滑入确在登记后，必须保留。

3_complete_minimal_premises.entry: 普通名人堂登记包装，不是PC浏览
3_complete_minimal_premises.state: 历史[]、编号0；玩家队伍有一合法健康非蛋Pikachu；默认ALLOW_EGGS=true、上限50、音乐Hall of Fame非空；无插件/竞争写入
3_complete_minimal_premises.dependencies: 前序场景/资源构造、身份查询正常；在首个音乐请求交付边界观察；不要求实际发声
3_complete_minimal_premises.observer: 同一全局历史数组长度与累计编号，在BGM请求发生时。

4_producer_consumer_and_phases.normal: 输入队伍/配置→基础画面构造→BGM请求→克隆/追加/编号→逐成员视觉链。请求时仍[]/0，正常登记后为一届/1。
4_producer_consumer_and_phases.cancel: 登记段没有玩家退出分支；PC浏览BACK不适用。
4_producer_consumer_and_phases.reject: 音乐配置空或无值跳过音乐请求，仍可登记；不是登记拒绝。
4_producer_consumer_and_phases.failure: 若在音乐请求内有界抛错且未返回，则登记调用尚未到；历史/编号仍原值。不保证错误窗口或整个应用退出。
4_producer_consumer_and_phases.partial_commit: 前序显示资源可能已建，音乐层可能已作自己的记录/请求；不推自动释放、恢复或保存。

5_counterexample_controls_and_negative.counterexample: 上述普通夹具，观察首次BGM请求边界：参考历史[]/编号0；将“记录先于包括BGM的演出”作顺序要求会预期已追加/1。
5_counterexample_controls_and_negative.near_control: 仅将音乐配置改空：无该BGM请求，记录仍先于逐成员滑入；原裁剪/编号/无取消/无保存合同都保留。
5_counterexample_controls_and_negative.negative_evidence: 完整新读Hall L1–494、登记包装和PC独立入口；本轮各任务findings的有界名人堂/BGM检索未见同根，但没有穷尽全历史去重。
5_counterexample_controls_and_negative.strongest_counterargument: “演出”可专指逐成员视觉动画，BGM可被作者视为开场设置；若根确认该解释，则本项仅可选措辞，不是必修新机制。

6_narrow_revision_and_preservation.minimal_revision: 可选改为“记录写入先于逐成员视觉演出；非空BGM请求在登记前”。不移动参考行为。
write_set_if_approved: WP67-B L141的一句限定；必要时补一条请求边界静态向量
preserve: 克隆/蛋配置/裁剪与上限0边界
无取消、无自动保存/片尾链
视觉滑入在登记后与媒体未知

original_proposal.author: R7-J16

decision_record.decision: 最低必要修订为WP67-B L141的一句顺序限定。全文§2把音乐纳入演出，§7.1又把BGM列为演出首项，因此“先于演出”不能在未说明的情况下改读成“先于逐成员视觉”。该句与非空音乐的静态请求次序相反。

strongest_counterargument.hypothesis: 演出是逐成员视觉，BGM只是开场设置；L22只说记录先于滑入，已足够。
strongest_counterargument.resolution: L22的局部正确不能撤销主文L17对presentation的明确定义，也不能从L143首项中排除BGM。媒体未验证只限制实际发声结论，不改变逻辑请求发生次序。

precise_claim.formal: WP67-B L141“记录写入（先于演出）”；L17演出包括音效/音乐，L143演出序列首项为BGM。
precise_claim.source: Hall L67–74为基础显示准备、非空音乐请求、记录登记、成员建立及淡入；L120–131为克隆/追加/编号/裁剪；L436–440包装在之后才进入动画循环。
precise_claim.layer: 逻辑BGM请求；不认证底层Audio调用必达、实际发声、像素、Demo可达或落盘。

premises.entry: 直接普通登记包装；不是PC浏览。
premises.state: 显式历史[]/累计编号0；一名有效非蛋健康Pikachu，默认音乐非空、上限50、ALLOW_EGGS真；无插件/竞争修改。
premises.dependencies: 基础画面构造与物种登记查询正常；观察外层逻辑BGM请求刚被交付时。登记正常对照还要求该请求、克隆和后续构造正常返回。
premises.observer: 同一历史数组内容和累计编号；补观察请求参数。

decision_record.ordinary_control: 空音乐配置：该音乐请求不存在；登记仍先于成员滑入。非空音乐正常返回：请求边界[]/0，之后追加一届/编号1，再进入视觉链。
decision_record.minimal_counterexample: 保持普通有效夹具，只观察第一次逻辑BGM请求入口：历史仍[]、编号仍0。若照L141+L143字面把登记放在BGM之前，观察值会是一届/1；无需注入错误即可区分。

phases.normal: 基础显示准备→非空BGM逻辑请求→克隆/追加/编号/裁剪→成员建立与淡入→动画循环。
phases.cancellation: 登记段无玩家取消分支；PC BACK不是登记取消。
phases.rejection: 空/无音乐只跳过请求，不拒绝记录；基本资源前置失败属于异常。
phases.failure: 若BGM请求内发生未返回的异常，登记尚未调用；不承诺消息窗口、宿主退出、恢复或清理。
phases.partial_commit: 此前显示资源可能已建立，音频消费者可已更改自己的播放请求状态；不推登记已提交，也不推自动保存/回滚。

necessary_consumers: Hall L178–211成员建立、L310–318/L347–401动画推进，确认视觉链在登记之后。
Audio_Play L52–68解析/分派；Game_System L44–83保留逻辑播放状态并按资源/默认音乐决定是否向Audio交付。因此只裁最外层请求先后。
Hall L471–478历史与编号查询以及L452–460 PC消费者保持各自门。

negative_evidence.scope: 完整Hall定义/包装/PC独立入口及已定位音频消费者；本轮所有tasks/*/findings.json的相关标题定位。
negative_evidence.result: 没有在该入口中找到把保存移到BGM之前的旁路；本轮标题定位未发现另一个同提案。非穷尽历史/动态插件证明。

history.existing_correct: L22只覆盖记录先于逐成员滑入，保持正确；上限0/裁剪/编号/PC门为旧边界，不合并。

phases.normal: 入口标志→场景建立→合格组快照→开组/刷新接点→统一净化；正常返回后才通用存放→清中心；列表还有下一项才询问。
